import sys, os, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/runner/work/sdlc-framework/sdlc-framework")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "plugin"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "plugin" / "gate"))

from lessons import index as lessons_mod  # noqa: E402
from gate import checks as checks_mod  # noqa: E402

print("=== Behavior 1: _supersedes_problem ===")
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
lessons_dir = tmp / "lessons"
lessons_dir.mkdir()

cases = {
    "absolute path": "/etc/passwd",
    "path outside lessons/ (climbs out)": "../secrets.md",
    "self-reference": "2026-01-self.md",
    "valid-looking but nonexistent": "2026-01-other.md",
}

for label, value in cases.items():
    lesson_name = "2026-01-self.md" if label == "self-reference" else "2026-01-caller.md"
    fm = {"supersedes": value}
    result = checks_mod._supersedes_problem(lessons_dir, lesson_name, fm)
    print(f"-- {label!r} (value={value!r}, lesson={lesson_name!r}): {result!r}")

# Confirm no leak: point supersedes at a real file outside lessons/ with sensitive-looking
# unparsable content, and show the message never contains that content.
outside = tmp / "secret.md"
outside.write_text("TOP-SECRET-CONTENT: this must never leak\nnot: valid: yaml: at: all:\n")
fm = {"supersedes": str(outside)}
result = checks_mod._supersedes_problem(lessons_dir, "2026-01-caller.md", fm)
print(f"-- absolute path to real unparsable file: {result!r}")
assert result is not None and "TOP-SECRET" not in result and "secret.md" not in result, "LEAK or wrong msg!"
print("   confirmed: message does not leak target content or path")

shutil.rmtree(tmp)

print()
print("=== Behavior 2: plugin/lessons/index.py build/check -> ## Unsorted on bad shapes ===")
tmp2 = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
lessons_dir2 = tmp2 / "lessons"
lessons_dir2.mkdir()

# case A: stale_after wrong type (int)
(lessons_dir2 / "2026-01-bad-stale-type.md").write_text(
    "---\n"
    "title: \"Bad stale type\"\n"
    "description: \"desc\"\n"
    "tags:\n  - flaky-test\n"
    "detected:\n  at: \"2026-01-05\"\n  tier: 2\n"
    "stale_after: 2027\n"
    "---\nBody\n"
)

# case B: detected.at out-of-range month
(lessons_dir2 / "2026-01-bad-month.md").write_text(
    "---\n"
    "title: \"Bad month\"\n"
    "description: \"desc\"\n"
    "tags:\n  - flaky-test\n"
    "detected:\n  at: \"2026-13-01\"\n  tier: 2\n"
    "---\nBody\n"
)

# case C: not valid UTF-8
(lessons_dir2 / "2026-01-not-utf8.md").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00bad bytes not utf8\n")

# add README.md and index.md which must be excluded
(lessons_dir2 / "README.md").write_text("# Lessons README\n")

try:
    text, notes = lessons_mod.build(tmp2, today="2026-10-08")
    print("build() did not raise. Notes:")
    for n in notes:
        print("  ", n)
    print("--- Unsorted section of generated index ---")
    in_unsorted = False
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("## Unsorted"):
            in_unsorted = True
        if in_unsorted:
            print("  ", line)
    assert "bad-stale-type" in text
    assert "bad-month" in text
    assert "not-utf8" in text
    print("CONFIRMED: all three bad-shaped files landed in index text (Unsorted), no crash")
except Exception as exc:
    print(f"CRASHED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

# Now write the index and test check()
(lessons_dir2 / "index.md").write_text(text, newline="\n")
ok, diff, notes2 = lessons_mod.check(tmp2, today="2026-10-08")
print(f"check() after writing matching index -> ok={ok}")
if not ok:
    print("diff:", diff[:500])

shutil.rmtree(tmp2)

print()
print("=== One input just outside acceptance: a VALID lesson (control, should NOT be Unsorted) ===")
tmp3 = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
lessons_dir3 = tmp3 / "lessons"
lessons_dir3.mkdir()
(lessons_dir3 / "2026-01-good.md").write_text(
    "---\n"
    "title: \"Good lesson\"\n"
    "description: \"desc\"\n"
    "tags:\n  - flaky-test\n"
    "detected:\n  at: \"2026-01-05\"\n  tier: 2\n"
    "---\nBody\n"
)
text3, notes3 = lessons_mod.build(tmp3, today="2026-10-08")
print(text3)
print("notes:", notes3)
shutil.rmtree(tmp3)
PYEOF
echo "script written"

cat > "$TMPDIR/verify_0003.py" << 'PYEOF'
import sys, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/runner/work/sdlc-framework/sdlc-framework")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "plugin"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "plugin" / "gate"))

from lessons import index as lessons_mod
from gate import checks as checks_mod

print("=== Behavior 1: _supersedes_problem ===")
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())

cases = dict()
cases["absolute path"] = "/etc/passwd"
cases["path outside lessons (climbs out)"] = "../secrets.md"
cases["self-reference"] = "2026-01-self.md"

    fm = dict(supersedes=value)
    result = checks_mod._supersedes_problem(lessons_dir, lesson_name, fm)
    print("--", repr(label), "value=", repr(value), "lesson=", repr(lesson_name), "->", repr(result))

outside = tmp / "secret.md"
outside.write_text("TOP-SECRET-CONTENT: this must never leak\nnot: valid: yaml: at: all:\n")
fm = dict(supersedes=str(outside))
result = checks_mod._supersedes_problem(lessons_dir, "2026-01-caller.md", fm)
print("-- absolute path to real unparsable file ->", repr(result))
assert result is not None
assert "TOP-SECRET" not in result
assert "secret.md" not in result

echo written
wc -l "$TMPDIR/verify_0003.py"

PR #132 updated: label `sdlc:e-ready` → `sdlc:needs-human`. This closes out the round per step 7.

## Report

PR [#132](https://github.com/luissiviero/sdlc-framework/pull/132) — gate (e): **parked**, `sdlc:needs-human`. Iterations: 3 used of cap 2 (non-routine).

What happened:
- Applied the owner's three "fix in this round" items (supersedes path/shape validation closing an arbitrary-file-read vector, two crash-to-`## Unsorted` fixes in the lessons index builder, one `sdlc-maintain.md` doc line), each with new tests — all green in isolation.
- Found and fixed two of my own plan.md/spec.md sync gaps the fixes left behind.
- Caught and fixed a stale `evidence/verifier.md` (and my own slip of not persisting a verifier sub-agent's report) before the final gate run.
- **Process error, mine**: I called `bump-iteration` a second time mid-round (to refresh the stale `findings` evidence) when the round was already registered once — there's no self-service undo, so the iteration counter is now 3 against a cap of 2, and gate (e) parks on that alone regardless of content.
- A side effect of the extra review re-runs triggered the framework's second-occurrence rule on 4 pre-existing nits (3 already owner-deferred to 0.3.7). Left unfixed in code per that rule's own escape hatch — documented in `evidence/review-response.md`, with the proposed `CLAUDE.md` lines carried into the PR body.

Left open: the owner's `sdlc:reset-iterations` label (or `set-iterations --count 0`) to open another round if wanted; otherwise everything else in this round is committed and green.
